title: Chapter 412
text:
Mad Blade's entire body was covered in lightning and thunder. The lighting effects were gorgeous, making him look even cooler.

"So, he got my Machinery Affinity." Han Xiao was paying attention to Mad Blade's match. He laughed and said, "This kid is really lucky. He even got this."

Through the status bar, the audience saw that this UFF had Han Xiao's name hanging on it. They could not help but be shocked.

Han Technician felt that it was very novel to appear in the players' league in such a manner. When he was creating the Ability Potion, he had only come up with this idea on a whim. Now, it seemed that other than earning him money, it had also given him a wave of fame.

The players were very familiar with Black Star's name. They did not expect to see Han Xiao's Character Summon Card in the competition. However, on second thought, Mad Blade … no, the Chinese players had been following Han Xiao in the galaxy, so it seemed normal for him to have Han Xiao's Character Summon Card.

The problem was that the effect of this Character Summon Card was too strong. Who could block 2.5 times Machinery Affinity at this stage?

Han Xiao's personal attributes were all question marks in the detection information of the players. They had never been able to figure out his true level, but now, there was finally a clue. His basic 2.5 times affinity, no wonder he was so strong. He was probably above level 100!

All along, Han Xiao had been a blessing in the eyes of the Mechanic class players. Now that he had shown the tip of the iceberg through Mad Blade, the Mechanic class players watching the match were very excited. It was as if they saw the great future of their class.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

Mad Blade did not dare waste any time. He took large strides and charged forward, jabbing with his gun, and continuously exploding. Even though Key of Solomon tried his best to dodge the attacks, the shockwave from the sudden increase in power was able to make his HP drop by a large chunk. Very soon, his HP dropped to around forty percent. The Magic Shield he summoned could not even block a single hit.

More than ten seconds ago, the one being beaten up was Mad Blade. Now, the situation was reversed. Key of Solomon could not fight back at all. He did not dare divert his attention to counterattack. If he did not dodge a single hit, he would be dead.

"This UFF's boost to the Mechanic class is too terrifying. If this continues, I have no chance of winning."

After the shock just now, Key of Solomon quickly adjusted his state of mind. His expression was gloomy. He had thought that he would definitely win this battle, but he did not expect his opponent to have such a powerful trump card.

Key of Solomon also had a hidden trump card. His original plan was to win this match, then deliberately lose the following matches so that he could advance and save his trump card for the finals. However, Mad Blade forced him to change his plan. If he kept his trump card, he would lose for sure. If he lost this match, he would not be able to go easy on the following matches. His opponents were all strong opponents, so he would not be able to conserve his strength and would definitely use his trump card. Since that was the case, he might as well use it now. As long as he could win this match, everything would be fine.

Mad Blade's sudden burst of power had indeed surprised him, but Key of Solomon quickly found a way to deal with it. He admitted that during the duration of [Black Star's Descent], Mad Blade was almost invincible. Whoever went up against him would die. However, this state only lasted for three minutes. As long as he could drag it out, he still had a chance of winning!

Coincidentally, his trump card, [Howling Gate], had such an effect!

Whoosh!

Key of Solomon used his last movement skill, [Flame Jump]. He disappeared from where he was and appeared in a sea of fire. He opened up a distance of more than twenty meters and quickly took off his necklace. He pressed it on the ground, and his mana instantly dropped by forty percent. The surging magic power emitted a misty blue light and flowed into the necklace, giving off a blinding light. At the same time, Key of Solomon started chanting.

"Spreading the frost of death, extinguishing the holy fire of life, building a bridge with the bloodline of the Demon Race, the most elite invaders, please respond to my call and let our enemies witness the winter that will freeze the world …"

Woo — hum —

An ethereal voice that seemed to come from the void sounded, and an icy-blue door of light formed by magic rose from the ground. Dark blue flames danced and blocked in front of the Key of Solomon. It was four meters tall, and there was a whirlpool-like magic inside the door. Majestic demon warriors more than three meters tall walked out of the door of light. They wore black metal armor that was covered in spikes, carried two-handed axes that were black and covered in dried blood, and held magic crossbows that flashed with an icy-blue halo. There was also a ranger at the front who was swinging a chain hammer and riding a demon wolf. There were a total of five demons.

This was the phantom of a scout team from the Extinction Army.

"He's … a Summoner!"

The commentator's tone suddenly rose, and his voice almost broke.

The audience's expression changed drastically.

One word could describe the image of a Summoner in the players' hearts.

— — Beast!

In his previous life, the Magic Summoner Style and the Mech Legion Style were known as the two hooligans. Balance? Skill? Sorry, I've never heard of those things. Anyway, I'm strong!

The human wave tactic could drown the enemy. If there were enough summoned creatures, the players could fight against many alone. At the current stage, there was no sign of the Army Style, but the Summoner Style was beginning to appear.

Of course, there were naturally restrictions for powerful styles. Summoning spells had a failure rate, and they needed a casting medium. Some were specific summoning items, some had to have certain abilities, and some had to sign a contract with the summoned creature. There were also a few forms of existence for summoned creatures. For example, they were real and unique, and they would disappear once they died. Key of Solomon summoned phantom entities, similar to the duplicate monsters in dungeons. They would be summoned again after they died, and there was no end to them. Real entities were mostly elite summoned creatures, and phantom entities were used as cannon fodder. His [Howling Door] was a pink Rare Level 60 summoning item that could summon the phantom of a scout team from the Demon Race.

The Demon Scout was a specialty of the Extinguish Army, and the [Howling Gate] was a personal challenge mission. It was very difficult and could only be completed by players above Level 60. However, Club Key had helped Key of Solomon obtain this pink item with their team's strength!

The attributes of these five Demon Race appeared in the status bar. Health: 2,500, Attack: 134-197, Defense: 40. At this level, the Summoner Style was still far from complete. Normal Summoners could only summon small creatures such as Forest Wolves and Venomous Snakes. Their attributes were not even one-third of the Demon Race's, but Key of Solomon could summon five Demon Race at once!

A Level 60 Pugilist player had around 3,000 to 4,000 health. These five Demon Race Scouts were equivalent to three Pugilists' health, and their damage was also very impressive. The highest theoretical damage from a round of focus fire was close to 1,000 points!

This was Key of Solomon's confidence that he was almost invincible. Not only was he a Frostfire Style Demon Mage, but he could also switch to the Summoner Style at any time.

The audience was still in awe of the strength of [Black Star's Descent], but the situation suddenly changed, and everyone was stunned.

"Damn, summoning a group of elite monsters. It's no different from a Boss!"

"There's such a move? Is this person a dog? "

Key of Solomon ordered the Demon Race Scout and two Demon Axemen to surround Mad Blade, and the two archers to protect him and shoot from afar.

He did not have much health left, and he was very wary of Mad Blade's attack, so he hid behind the archers.

With a solemn expression, Frenzied Sword raised his shield and spear and charged forward in large strides. His steel armor collided with the three-headed demon with a loud bang, and the surrounding air was blown away by the impact. The audience only felt that the screen shook for a moment.

Boom! Pa!

Immediately after, the tip of the spear released smoke and sparks. Mad Blade swung his spear and hit the three Demons at the same time. The audience could see that a quarter of the health of the three Demon Race Scouts was gone in an instant.

With the bonus of [Black Star's Descent], Mad Blade's damage was extremely terrifying. Not only that, but the defense of his armor also increased tremendously, and he was not afraid of being surrounded.

"I just need to stall for three minutes …" Key of Solomon was frustrated. In his eyes, the first time he used [Howling Gate] in front of the world, it should have been a crushing victory. However, the first time he used it, it was actually to stall the opponent and cover his retreat.

Embarrassing!

Just as the two of them were fighting, the number of people watching increased. This match was full of twists and turns, and it attracted more and more viewers.

The appearance of summoning made the audience think that the situation would change again, or at least become evenly matched again. However, the next scene was still Mad Blade's one-man show. He beat up a team of Demon Race Scouts by himself, and the Summoner, who should have crushed the opponent, was still being beaten by Mad Blade.

"… Summoner is a very powerful class. Hmm … Although Key of Solomon is at an absolute disadvantage now, this does not affect the strength of the Summoner …" The commentator was originally analyzing the reason why the Summoner was so strong, but when he saw this scene, he felt that his persuasiveness was greatly reduced. He could only force himself to continue.

This does not make sense!

Many contestants were also watching this match with heavy hearts. "Key of Solomon has a powerful summoning item. Unlike Mad Blade's one-time Character Summon Card, his summoning can be used continuously. This guy is a strong opponent. We have to formulate a plan to deal with him in advance …"

Although the contestants from various countries were more afraid of Key of Solomon, they could not help but rejoice. "Luckily, this [Black Star's Descent] status is only a one-time use. Otherwise, we would have no chance …"

…

Key of Solomon felt that this was the longest three minutes. The Demon Race Scouts that he had high hopes for were all chopped up by Mad Blade like vegetables. He looked at the time. It had only been two minutes. Mad Blade's status could last for at least thirty seconds, but he was already at his wit's end.

The audience was happy to see this.

"Awesome. Three minutes of being a real man. If someone blocks him, he will kill them. If Buddha blocks him, he will kill Buddha. He will create a new world!"

"What Black Star's Descent? This is clearly called the Sky Demon Disintegration Technique!"

"A Summoner can be beaten up? How embarrassing. Take off your skirt! "

"Key of Solomon: What can I do? I'm also in despair!"

"This is like a high-level account bullying noobs. Tsk, speaking of which, with so many mechanical bonuses, Mad Blade's Furious Sword is indeed equivalent to a high-level account."

"Haha, I'm dying of laughter. This Summoner is like a team wipe in a Boss dungeon. Look at his eyes. How lost."

Pu!

The spear pierced into Key of Solomon's chest without any obstruction. He grabbed the spear with a face full of unwillingness and anger. He had used his trump card, but he still lost. He even let the others know about his trump card in advance.

He had suffered a huge loss in this battle. He had suffered a double loss!

Boom!

An explosion occurred in his body, taking away the last bit of his health. Key of Solomon turned into white light and died.

The commentator waved his fist and said excitedly.

"What an exciting battle. Congratulations to Mad Blade's Furious Sword for obtaining the final victory!"

…

The ratings for this match were extremely high, and the number of replays increased rapidly. Players from all over the world were talking about this match, especially the Summoner Style being beaten up.

As Mad Blade had defeated his opponent with [Black Star's Descent] UFF, Han Xiao's presence was indirectly increased.

This mysterious NC character that had been active in the eyes of the players since the start of the server finally showed the tip of the iceberg of his strength. Han Technician was now a topic of discussion. His past deeds were made into memes by the players. As long as there were related posts, it was very easy to attract a bunch of people to make memes on the forums. This time, it caused the players to speculate about his abilities, guessing what skills he had as a Mechanic, what style he belonged to, and so on.

Mad Blade had defeated a strong opponent, and his chances of qualifying had increased. Key of Solomon's biggest trump card had been forced out, but he had lost in the end. A Summoner that was supposed to be like a Boss had become the one fighting the Boss. After the match, many reporters asked Key of Solomon how it felt to be beaten up as a Summoner. It was as if they were stabbing at the wound in his heart with a knife, and they left angrily.

In fact, his [Howling Gate] was indeed very strong. In the following group matches, in order to ensure his qualification, he could only go all out and use [Howling Gate] to defeat strong opponents one after another, showing the strength of a Summoner. However, the better he performed, the more it showed how overpowered Mad Blade was … or rather, how overpowered Han Xiao's Character Summon Card was.

Mad Blade got rid of the entanglement of the post-match interview and hurriedly returned to the stronghold to find Han Xiao. He had tasted the sweetness of the Ability Potion and had turned the tide. The more of such good things the better.

When he arrived at Han Xiao's room, the people from Dynasty, Temple of God, and Long Sky had already surrounded Han Xiao. They had all watched the match and were fighting to buy Black Star's Ability Potion.

However, there was no new stock on the shop interface.

Everyone raised their heads and looked at Han Xiao. This scene gave Han Xiao the illusion that these players were pigs waiting to be fed, and he was the mother feeding them.

"What are you looking at? You want the Ability Potion? There's no more! "

Han Xiao chased everyone out.
